Iron Mountain AZP-1 is a data center campus in Phoenix, Arizona, operated by Iron Mountain as part of the company's hyperscale business. The facility's IT capacity is not published. Without a published power or capacity figure, this campus cannot be assessed for its relevance to AI scaling based on compute density or power availability.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities, of which only four publish power specifications totaling 512 MW. Iron Mountain AZP-1 does not contribute to this published total. The state context shows substantial unmeasured capacity: most facilities in Arizona publish no figures, so the true scale of available compute in the state remains opaque.

This campus's role in AI infrastructure cannot be determined from published specifications. To evaluate whether it matters to AI scaling, you would need to contact Iron Mountain directly for IT load, cooling capacity, and power allocation to machine learning workloads.
